projects.title: No Code EDA
bulletPoints: Redesigned the data analysis workflow with AI assisted human computer interaction (HCI) principles.
Enabling users to sort, filter, reorder, and visualize datasets through natural language interaction with an AI assistant.
Full stack development using Next.js, FastAPI, and OpenAPI to connect chatbots with EDA tool calls.
Integrated the Meridian package (UCSD developer package) to data bind CSV data with visualizations.
Built isolated, version controlled analysis environments for collaborative EDA workflows similar to Google Docs.

projects.title: DeckScan
bulletPoints: Developed a computer vision application to automatically scan and reconstruct poker card orderings, increasing data collection efficiency by about 3x.
Processed and analyzed 600+ wash shuffle trials using DeckScan, generating large scale datasets for probabilistic modeling and statistical analysis.
Next.js and Python tie image capture to batch inference and structured CSV exports so trial runs stay organized and reproducible.

projects.title: Signal Normalization
bulletPoints: Web app with React and Node.js that processes fluorescent signal Excel data, turning raw plate and well layouts into a standardized format and cutting manual preprocessing time by about 50%.
Python pipelines with pandas and openpyxl normalize uploaded datasets for consistent scaling.
Automated summary statistics and structured tables enable direct import into GraphPad Prism and faster downstream analysis.

projects.title: Ecommerce Dashboard
bulletPoints: Ecommerce dashboard that brings spreadsheet style workflows to a mobile first experience.
Next.js frontend, MongoDB backend, and Google Authentication for secure user access.
Product, order, and reporting views tailored for small business style operations.

projects.title: CrunchyRoll Award Data Analysis
bulletPoints: Collected, cleaned, and wrangled multiple data frames from award and viewership sources.
Analyzed relationships between total views, genre, manga sales, and related factors.
Built a predictive model with data visualization to summarize patterns in the dataset.
